name: Reries
subtitle: BootlegYouki's apps
description: Every app here keeps its data on your phone: no account, no cloud sync.

apps.name: Setsu
apps.subtitle: Personal finance tracker
apps.localizedDescription: Track budgets, expenses, goals and debts. Everything stays on your iPhone, with backups you can export and restore.

versions.localizedDescription: Transfer money between sources, like MariBank to Cash, from a source's page: both balances change without counting as spending or income. New icons throughout, a proper sort icon, and the Include Debt in Balance setting is gone since debts now move money themselves.

Budgets are now sources. Debts move money through a source with a date, and their entries change only through the debt. Editing a debt can fix Paid So Far, and a half-paid debt can be written off or undone. The source named MariBank earns MariBank's daily interest at 1 AM. Activity has Clear All, backups leave the activity list out, and only the Undo button undoes.
Sort, filter and More moved into the navigation bar. Debts has no search field. Fixed: opening Goals or Debts from Home could leave the page's layout broken until restart.

Undo after every add, edit and delete. Fixed swipe-to-delete hiding a budget before you confirmed. Standard alerts for deleting and erasing. Home: larger quick entries below Goals and Debts. Sheets ignore rapid repeat taps.

Add and edit sheets resize smoothly between steps. The date sits under the amount in the first step, and the last step is a taller notes field. Sheets have no close button: swipe down or tap outside to close.
Quick entry buttons on Home show only the name; the amount still shows when you confirm.
Add and edit sheets fit their contents; quick entry confirm is a clear alert; Budget total shows Over Budget instead of a negative amount.
Light and dark mode, solid cards, budget search, sort and edit, working quick entries, in-page search and filter buttons. Removed Analytics, Calendar and Recurring Expenses.

Forms ask one thing at a time with Back and Next, items and lists use Liquid Glass, the Budget tab shows each budget with its own page, budgets can be deleted (expenses stay, under No Budget), a splash screen at launch, and a Show Labels setting for icon-only tabs.
Import Backup works in copies installed with KSign: picking the backup file now opens it instead of doing nothing.
Backup import works again: after you pick a backup file, the confirmation now appears instead of being lost, and it is a standard alert with Cancel and Replace.
The balance card is now a Liquid Glass card stack: your other budgets peek out behind it, and tapping sends the front card to the back.
iOS 26 design with the Liquid Glass tab bar, backup export and restore in Settings, the bamboo app icon, and Analytics and Calendar as native lists.
First release of Setsu for iPhone.

apps.name: Tabi
apps.subtitle: Applicant manager for overseas deployment
apps.localizedDescription: Track applicants going abroad: requirements, appearance reminders, cash advances, sub-agents and work expenses, plus open DFA passport appointment dates. Everything stays on your iPhone, with backups you can export and restore.

versions.localizedDescription: Passport dates load again: the DFA check closes after Start an Appointment and says what to tap.
Passport appointment dates load again. If the DFA website asks to check you're human, tap the box once and the dates load.
Vaccine replaces TESDA as a cash advance milestone, normal text sizes, step-by-step requirement expenses, in-page search and buttons, solid cards. Removed Print Report.

First release of Tabi: applicants and their requirements, appearance reminders, cash advances in pesos or dollars, sub-agents, work expenses, a printable report, and open DFA passport appointment dates per site.

apps.name: Denki
apps.subtitle: Turn your PC on and off
apps.localizedDescription: Turn your PC on and off from your iPhone and see its CPU, memory and uptime. Needs the Denki daemon on the PC, Tailscale, and a Pico W on your home network to wake it. Connect by scanning the QR code the daemon shows.

versions.localizedDescription: Claude chat: answer field on question cards no longer types stray numbers.
Claude chat: question card shows only the live question.
Claude chat: new question card, Other panes removed.
Claude chat: close panes by swiping, one-row ring usage card, reopens your last chat.
Claude chat: title chooser instead of the sidebar, read-only view of other Herdr panes, one expandable usage bar.
Claude chat: minimal floating usage pill with rings for context, 5 hour and weekly limits.
Claude chat: Codex sessions listed again, swipe and tap fixes for the sessions menu.
Claude chat: tidier usage card with bars for context, 5 hour and weekly limits.
Claude chat: context and usage limits at the top, messages send instantly, easier composer taps, Stop on first tap.
Fixed the + button in the Claude chat and a faded message that could stay stuck.
Claude chat: log in to the PC from the chat and open Herdr, floating liquid glass reply box, faded queued messages, no Refresh button, smoother swipe to open the sessions menu.
Claude chat: attach photos, cleaner question card, swipe to open the sessions menu, send while Claude works, steadier scrolling and smoother animations.
The Claude chat now looks like the Claude app: only replies show, commands are tucked into a row you can expand, and sessions live in a side menu.
New Claude button on the Power screen: read your Claude Code sessions running on the PC, reply, stop them and answer their permission prompts from your phone.
Copy, Paste, Undo and Super buttons in Mouse mode. No more finger circles when you swipe in full zoom.
Left and right click buttons in full zoom. Hold the left click button and move on the trackpad to select text or drag. Full zoom turns on as soon as the trackpad gets too small to use.
Sunshine login is now a half-height sheet with a big Save button and AutoFill, and shows when your PC already has the login saved.

New pairing screen with Cancel and an Open Sunshine button. Pair asks for your Sunshine login if the PC doesn't have it, then pairs in one go. Fixed pairing getting stuck with 'a pairing session with this uniqueid already exists'.

Pairing with Sunshine is one tap: Denki enters the PIN on the PC for you. Needs the Denki 1.10.0 PC app with your Sunshine login entered once in Setup. If the PC can't be reached, the PIN shows like before.
Saved PCs: tap PCs on the Power screen to switch between paired PCs, add another, or swipe to forget one. Your current PC is kept.
The click buttons under the trackpad are plain pads like a laptop's, without text.
Left Click and Right Click buttons under the trackpad. Tap Super twice to press it alone. Done closes the keyboard before leaving Remote, and the Power screen no longer jumps up afterwards.
Tapping On retries once by itself when the send fails, so you no longer have to keep tapping.

Remote is portrait only now. The scroll bar on the left is an up/down joystick: drag further for faster scrolling. At full zoom the stream itself becomes the trackpad. Send to PC, Copy from PC and Unpair are in the ⋯ menu. A close-keyboard button sits next to the typing preview. Japanese and other non-English characters type correctly on the PC. Fixed the header buttons not responding while zoomed.
Type straight onto the PC with a live preview and cursor, zoom slider with two-finger panning, every finger shows on the trackpad, more room for the stream, and the Lock button works again.
Log in at the PC's login screen before the stream starts, no more key button, and trackpad circles no longer get stuck.
Type your PC's login password from the Remote screen, a chat-style typing bar with preview, and typing that no longer submits after every letter.
Opening Remote now starts Sunshine on the PC, so it no longer has to run all the time.
Send and copy text between the iPhone and the PC from the Remote screen, Lock and Restart buttons, and a trackpad that shows your fingers with a short trail.
The processor, memory and uptime numbers are gone from the main screen.
Remote: see the PC screen live from Sunshine with a trackpad and keyboard below, plus a sideways fullscreen mode. The Claude Remote button is gone.
New Claude Remote button while the PC is on: it opens herdr on the PC, closes the Claude session there and starts claude remote, so you can pick it up from the Claude app.
Holding the power button to shut down looks like a normal press again. Pairing links opened from outside the app now ask before connecting.
Turn your PC on and off and see its CPU, memory and uptime. Connect by scanning the QR code from the daemon. Hold the power button to shut down. Removed the AI Terminal.
